<section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/types/text-and-literal-types/">Text, bytes and literal types</a><span class="nv-section-count">7</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">A string is UTF-8 for its whole lifetime, bytes is its unencoded peer, and a literal can be a type of its own.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/text-and-literal-types/#ordering">Only the types the table orders may be ordered, and two objects need <code>Comparable</code></a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/text-and-literal-types/#string-is-utf8">A <code>string</code> is valid UTF-8 for its whole lifetime, and its unmarked unit is the grapheme cluster</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/text-and-literal-types/#bytes"><code>bytes</code> is a primitive peer to <code>string</code> for data that carries no encoding</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/text-and-literal-types/#duration-literal"><code>1h30m</code> is a <code>Core\Time\Duration</code> constant, in one grammar shared by source, <code>parse</code> and <code>nvs.toml</code></a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/text-and-literal-types/#literal-types">A <code>string</code> or <code>int</code> literal is its own type, and a union of them is a closed set</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/text-and-literal-types/#constant-in-type-position">A scalar class constant used as a type folds to its own literal type</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/text-and-literal-types/#enum-case-type">An enum case used as a type is a narrowed subtype of its enum, never its backing integer</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span></li></ol>
</section>
<section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/types/arrays-and-property-keys/">Arrays and property keys</a><span class="nv-section-count">7</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">PHP's ordered hash with a declared element type, and the type whose values are a class's own property names.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/arrays-and-property-keys/#arrays">An array is PHP's ordered hash with <code>string</code> keys and a declared element type</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/arrays-and-property-keys/#array-combination">Three combining members treat every key alike, and <code>array + array</code> does not compile</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/arrays-and-property-keys/#preserve-keys"><code>{preserveKeys: false}</code> discards every key, whatever shape the key has</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/arrays-and-property-keys/#mixed-subscript">A subscript through a <code>mixed</code> is the tag's question; <section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/types/unions-and-conversion/">Unions, narrowing and conversion</a><span class="nv-section-count">8</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">What a union permits, the four spellings of narrowing, and the single conversion operator that replaced the cast.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/unions-and-conversion/#unions-and-mixed">A union permits only what every member permits, and <code>mixed</code> is the one position checked <section class="nv-section">
<h2 class="nv-section-title"><a href="/docs/rules/types/closures/">Closures and callables</a><span class="nv-section-count">9</span></h2>
<p class="nv-section-blurb">One closure literal, one callable type, capture by value with no <code>use</code> clause, and the variance that follows.</p>
<ol class="nv-rule-list"><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/closures/#callable-is-a-closure"><code>callable</code> is satisfied by a closure and by nothing else, and no object is callable</a><span href="/docs/rules/types/closures/#closure-literal"><code>fn</code> is the only closure literal, with an expression body or a block body</a><span class="nv-rule-list-status" data-status="shipped">Shipped</span><span class="nv-rule-list-flag" title="Differs from PHP">PHP</span></li><li><a href="/docs/rules/types/closures/#callable-signature">A <code>callable</code> type
